units: <cite ref="Arakhin 16b:11-12">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא עושה מעשה פ׳ … קרבן פ׳</he> he (the leper) does the work of a babbler (speaks evil of men), therefore the Torah said, let him offer a babbler (a chirping bird) as a sacrifice; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 559:7">Yalk. Lev. 559</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:8">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>אני</he> … <he>שפ׳ אתה יש באחיך פ׳ וכ׳</he> I see, thou (Jadah) art the talker; is there among thy brothers a talker like thee?; Tanḥ. Vayigg. 5 <he>אני רואה</he> … <he>ואתה פ׳</he> I see in my cup that there are older men among thy brothers, and yet thou art the talker?—V. <cite ref="D00087"><he>דַּבְּרָן</he></cite>.
